title: PortableText preview renderer
description: Build the read/preview side: a Vue component that renders a Sanity post body with `@portabletext/vue`, porting the `components` map from blog-implementation-guide.md. Cover the standard blocks plus the custom marks and styles the schema uses (lead, pullquote, underline, highlight, code, internal/external links) and the inline `image` type via `@sanity/image-url`. Apply the explicit `list-style` fix so lists keep their markers under a CSS reset. Each custom body type MUST have a renderer (missing renderers fail silently).
acceptance_criteria: A `<BlogPostPreview>` component renders a post body including headings, lists, links, and inline images.
Custom marks/styles from the schema (lead, pullquote, highlight, internalLink) render correctly; internalLink resolves to an in-app route.
Ordered and unordered lists display their markers (explicit `list-style` applied in the post scope).
Adding a body block type without a renderer is caught by a test or documented checklist so it does not fail silently.

comments.body: DONE + VERIFIED + REVIEWED. BlogPostPreview + createPortableComponents (lead/pullquote, underline/highlight/link/internalLink, image via @sanity/image-url named createImageUrlBuilder); list-style fix; loud unknownType/Mark/BlockStyle guard + honest coverage checklists (CUSTOM_MARKS + DELEGATED_DECORATOR_MARKS for strike/code). Verification: build OK, 59/59 tests, lint 0 errors, console clean of the @sanity/image-url deprecation and the [Vue warn] reactive-component warning (both fixed: test uses named export; toRaw+markRaw at the h() call site). Reviewer (render-reviewer) round-trip resolved all HIGH/MEDIUM. @portabletext/vue@1.0.14 matches the coded v1 API.
